newsitem.title: USA: Dominion group aims to replace management.
newsitem.headline: Dominion group aims to replace management.

text.p: The Committee to Revitalize Dominion Bridge Corp said on Monday that it has issued materials to shareholders for consent to remove chairman Michel Marengere and other senior managers of the company.
The group said it has set July 18, 1997 as the goal for getting the written consents from a majority of shareholders.
The committee may choose to extend the date up to August 19, 1997, which is the final day for the consents to be obtained, the committee said.
Dominion Bridge was not immediately available for comment.
Dominion Bridge has conceded the committee's right to obtain a list of shareholders after a legal dispute over this, the committee said.
